question: Who among the following has been conferred the Padma Vibhushan award in 2021 in the field of medicine?
solution:
The correct answer is __**B. Monaappa Hegde**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Dr. B. Monaappa Hegde is a renowned medical professional recognized for his contributions to the field of medicine.
 
• He was conferred with the Padma Vibhushan award in 2021, which is one of the highest civilian awards in India.
 
• The Padma Vibhushan is awarded for "exceptional and distinguished service" in any field including service rendered by Government servants.
 
• Dr. Hegde has significantly contributed to the advancement of medical science and healthcare in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Padma Awards**

 
 
• The Padma Awards are one of the highest civilian honors of India announced annually on the eve of Republic Day.
 
• They are given in three categories: Padma Vibhushan (for exceptional and distinguished service), Padma Bhushan (distinguished service of higher order), and Padma Shri (distinguished service).
 
• The awards seek to recognize achievements in all fields of activities or disciplines where an element of public service is involved.
 
• The nomination process is open to the public, and the awards are conferred by the President of India.
 
 
 
• **Medical Contributions**
 
 
• Contributions to the field of medicine include advancements in medical research, improved patient care, and innovations in medical treatments.
 
• Recipients of the Padma Vibhushan in medicine often have a significant impact on public health policies and practices.
 
• These contributions can also include the development of new medical procedures, therapies, or technologies.
 
 
 
• **Other Notable Recipients in 2021**
 
 
• **Sudarshan Sahoo** - He was awarded the Padma Vibhushan for his contributions to art.
 
• **B. B. Lal** - He was recognized for his work in archaeology.
 
• **Narinder Singh Kapany** - Known as the father of fiber optics, he was honored for his contributions to science and technology.
